text:
lia: Quick heads-up — I'm doing a small style sweep on PR #2914. Noticed mixed camelCase/snake_case in pkg/network and a couple files with trailing whitespace.

dave: which files? can you paste the paths?

lia: sure — snippet: `pkg/network/rpc_client.go` (fields: `peer_id` vs `peerID`), `pkg/network/conn_test.go` (fmt diffs), and `internal/metrics/README.md` has stray tabs.

sam: easy wins. We should run `gofumpt -w .` and `gofmt -s -w .` then run the linter.

lia: yea running locally now: `gofumpt` fixed 7 files. leaving comments on the PR for the naming change — small API surface but want to avoid breaking consumers.

priyanka: I can pick up the whitespace and README tab -> spaces if you want. I'll open a tiny follow-up PR and reference #2914.

lia: awesome, thanks @priyanka — please follow the repo conventions: initialisms uppercase (ID, HTTP), but prefer `peerID` over `peer_id`. leave a note in the changelog fragment.

priyanka: will do. anything else blocking merge?

sam: also saw one test failing in CI on `package/net` unrelated to formatting — CI flagged a race in TestConnReuse. leaving a comment.

lia: noted. tagging @dave for test ownership — can you take a look?

dave: yep I'll reproduce locally and fix or file a follow-up. aiming to have either fix or an issue by EOD.

lia: plan: if priyanka's whitespace PR lands and dave/CI are green by merge window at 18:00 UTC, I'll squash+merge. if not, we'll hold and re-run the style sweep next day.

merge-bot: Merge window reminder: 18:00 UTC today.

ci-bot: CI: lint passed on latest commit, tests running (3/12).

priyanka: opened follow-up PR #2915 for whitespace + README, linked to #2914. :thumbsup:

lia: thanks — will watch. if anything blocks, ping here.

sam: small note for follow-ups — prefer adding a short comment in the PR body listing the automated commands you ran (gofumpt/gofmt/golangci-lint) so reviewers can re-run easily.

lia: good call. adding to the checklist.

priyanka: added commands to PR body. merging once CI green and dave confirms test.

last message: lia: keeping this thread pinned until merged.
